# Synthetic Moodle user report

`self-report.html` is hand-authored using the pinned upstream Moodle markup
documented in [source research](../../../../docs/research/2026-11-15-moodle-academic-data-sources.md).
It includes semantic column and row headers, category paths, a category
spacer, manual items with the same title, a published total, and a grade
cell displaying only the submission date. The `data-grade-state` markers
exercise explicit ungraded and restriction semantics supplied by a
synthetic source. An unqualified dash remains unknown.

The fixture contains fictitious values and identities. It supplies no
evidence about Quanta's deployment, access rules, locale, or polling effects.
